title: Howdy H-Town Street Art & Small Bar Tour
includes: Howdy's Ultimate Guide to Houston- a curated list of things to do in Houston
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
PUBLIC TOURS AVAILABLE OCTOBER - APRIL 

On a Howdy H-Town Street Art & Small Bar Tour we will explore the Sculptures, Graffiti Art, Architecture and Small Bars that make Downtown Houston unique. Walk through the skyscrapers and pop into the small bars as your guide brings the city to life telling stories. The tour includes two drinks (Alcoholic/Non-Alcoholic). The perfect way to start your Friday night in Downtown Houston, end a long work week or meet new friends. Grab social media content or impress your date with the vibrant art Houston has to offer.
